title: Ohm Brew Rockin Raspberry Sorbet 50/50 Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: A juice that’s shot to the top of our favourite dessert flavours, Ohm Brew’s Raspberry Sorbet folds fresh raspberries into a sweet, cool sorbet with a squeeze of lemon for a bright citrus note and a touch of vanilla for sophistication. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
